canonical_asset.provenance: Exact binary promotion of the approved transparent capture button asset used by Empty Home V2.2; no redraw, regeneration or recompression.

rendered_size.rule: Scale the canonical 208×208 asset to the page size token; do not raster-redesign it.

visual.rim: fine warm-gold static rim already baked into the canonical asset
visual.depth: restrained edge depth; no heavy floating shadow

supporting_motion_assets.role: animated sweep highlight only; not part of the static canonical image
animated breathing support only; not part of the static canonical image

prohibited: redrawing or regenerating the canonical button
compositing the gold-rim sweep mask as a permanent second rim
baking page background into the button asset
changing the camera glyph proportions without a new component version
